item.title: Judge says Pentagon's measures against Anthropic were 'illegal and baseless'
item.description: A judge issued a written order Thursday night that the Pentagon acted illegally by punishing the AI company for its criticism of the Department of Defense's views on AI use. The government is expected to fight the ruling.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The role of climate change in the Nepal floods
item.description: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.
item.content:encoded: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.
item.dc:creator: Julia Simon

item.title: Helicopter pilot describes what he's seen rescuing people in Nepal
item.description: Andy Thapa is a charter and rescue pilot for a Nepali helicopter company. He's been rescuing people stranded by the catastrophic flooding, and carrying them to safety.

item.title: Trump directs federal government to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America

item.title: Ratko Mladic, ex-Bosnian Serb warlord who oversaw atrocities, has died at 84
item.description: Ratko Mladic was one of the most notorious figures of a war that killed over 100,000 people in the 1990s. He commanded his troops to "scorch the brains" of the Bosnian Muslims and boasted of being a "Serbian God."
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Peter Dejong)

item.title: The real cause of most wildfires? People
item.description: More than three quarters of all wildfires in the U.S. are caused by human behavior including accidents, negligence and arson.
